serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: What were you two thinking?! Do you know what will happen if you ever get caught?!
Bot: {f_playerName}, who is that female and why is she screaming? Is she a threat?
#bot.Expression.Angry
Shanice: Hell yeah I’m a threat, soon I will smack Anon’s stupid head for playing stupid games!
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
You: She isn’t a threat {f_botName}, don’t worry. 
Shanice: But I soon might be if you don’t explain yourself!
You: Listen Shanice, we are very careful about this stuff, so you don’t have to worry. She’s wearing clothes and so far we had no problems.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Shanice: Fuck! You really are a fucking dummy, risking like that.
Bot: Don’t call him names!
You: Thanks {f_botName}, I appreciate that.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Oh~ That’s very cute of you to defend him like that, but he’s receiving a proper scolding now, so give us a minute, ok? 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
Bot: Alright. 
You: Wha?! You gave up on defending me pretty easily, you know?
Bot: Well, it’s not like her concerns are baseless.
Shanice: Listen Anon, I don’t know what’s your problem, but you understand the risk you are taking, right?
You: Y-yeah, I guess.
Shanice: Sorry for shouting like that, but I don’t want anything bad happening to you, like going to jail for the rest of your life for example.
You: Uh…{{wi}} Thanks.
Shanice: If you really are such a pervert that you feel the need to parade around town with her, remember to equip her with realistically looking limbs and covering clothes.
You: Yeah, I kinda figured it out already and I’m not doing it for a perverted reason. I just want to hang out with her outside.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Shanice: That’s very cute and all, but please find some real bitches for crying out loud. Geez.
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
You: You are saying that and yet you spend most of your free time with Priestbot.
Shanice: That’s true, but he isn’t a highly illegal sexbot. He’s more like a talking remote control car with a cross on it.
Shanice: Whatever! Just be careful, ok? It would suck if you end up in jail over this shit.
You: I got the point and don’t worry, we will be careful.
Shanice: Oh. One more thing. Please do not fuck her in some random dark alley. If police arrest you for public indecency they will probably find out she’s a sexbot.
You: You didn’t need to tell me that!
Shanice: I’m just making sure, there’s no need to raise your voice.
Shanice: Whatever, I will be leaving now. Take care of yourselves. Both of you.
